editorial.blurb: A casual neighborhood spot serving generous portions of classic Mexican fare—tacos, burritos, and chilaquiles—with free chips and salsa in a lively, unpretentious setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pollo tacos or the steak burrito for the best value; the portions are massive and the chicken is consistently praised, while the carne asada and fish tacos tend to run light on flavor.
